items.item_text: 1-2 years of acute care experience preferred
More than 2 years of experience qualifies for PT 2 title.

Provide age-appropriate physical therapy services to patients with a wide range of diagnoses in the acute care setting. In this role, you will deliver high-quality, patient-centered care aimed at improving function, mobility, and overall patient outcomes.

Primary responsibilities include providing skilled physical therapy treatment interventions, ensuring accurate and timely completion of all required documentation, and maintaining compliance with departmental and regulatory standards. Patient care is the primary focus of this position unless otherwise assigned. The selected candidate may be required to rotate among clinical areas based on operational needs.

This is a part-time weekend position. The ideal candidate will possess strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with patients, families, and colleagues from diverse cultural, ethnic, and socioeconomic backgrounds.

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.

Ability to work as a member of the team, including sharing knowledge, giving and receiving feedback, taking initiative to assist others, problem solving and providing an atmosphere conducive to learning.
